figure_intent.purpose: Explain the scientific-figure generation workflow as a bounded, evidence-grounded pipeline.
figure_intent.core_claim: A final image model becomes more controllable when it receives dual references, a topology plan, color roles, and an SVG contract.
figure_intent.novelty_focus: Separate semantic-structural RAG and high-aesthetic domain references are combined before a topology-locked SVG is rendered.
figure_intent.scope: Conceptual workflow diagram, not a benchmark result.

color_plan.selection_principle: A cohesive palette is selected per figure from available aesthetic evidence; colors are roles, not global fixed brand values.
